_comment: Gradient colour interpolation must happen in PREMULTIPLIED alpha (css-images-3 §3.4.2 / css-images-4 §3.4.4: 'colors are interpolated in premultiplied sRGB by default'). This is the single most common reimplementation bug: a naive lerp of the four unpremultiplied channels drags every stop toward `transparent`'s rgb of (0,0,0), so a red->transparent ramp develops a DARK band it must not have. Nothing in fixtures/visual-test.json (the 327-pair gating corpus) has a translucent gradient stop, and the one fixture that does (color/background-blend-mode.json) confounds it with a blend mode and records no expected value. Every box is 200x60, `to right`, so the ramp parameter is t = x/200 and every row is identical; sample at y=40, which is clear of the harness's block-font name label (glyph band y in [6,13), x from 8, tools/visual/block-font.json). Expected at t: see each _note. THE HEADLINE ASSERTION: in GA_RedToTransparent_White the RED channel must read 255 at EVERY x; non-premultiplied interpolation dips to 191 at the midpoint and 207 at the quartiles, touching 255 only at the two ends. MUST MATCH (sampled pixel equality at each x, label band excluded): GA_RedToTransparent_White == GA_RedToTransparentRed_White == GA_RedToWhite_White, and GA_RedToTransparent_Black == GA_RedToBlack_Black, and GA_BlueToTransparent_White == GA_BlueToTransparentBlue_White. Each pair's second member is an algebraic identity of the first under the SPEC rule and differs from it under the naive rule, so a mismatch localises the fault to interpolation rather than to compositing. GA_UniformHalfAlphaRed_White carries no interpolation at all and isolates plain source-over compositing: if it is wrong, none of the others can be read.

GA_RedToTransparentRed_White._note: CONTROL for the row above: both interpolation models agree because the two stops share rgb. Expected identical to GA_RedToTransparent_White at every x: (255, 255t, 255t).

GA_RedToWhite_White._note: SECOND CONTROL, fully opaque so alpha is not involved at all: (255,255t,255t). Under the spec rule this is pixel-identical to both rows above; if it matches GA_RedToTransparentRed_White but not GA_RedToTransparent_White, interpolation is non-premultiplied.

GA_RedToTransparent_Black._note: Same ramp over a BLACK backdrop, so the error flips sign and cannot be explained by a backdrop mistake. SPEC: (255(1-t),0,0) -> t=.25 (191,0,0) · t=.5 (128,0,0) · t=.75 (64,0,0). NAIVE: (255(1-t)^2,0,0) -> t=.5 (64,0,0), t=.25 (143,0,0).

GA_RedToBlack_Black._note: CONTROL for the row above, opaque: (255(1-t),0,0). Must be pixel-identical to GA_RedToTransparent_Black under the spec rule.

GA_UniformHalfAlphaRed_White._note: No interpolation (both stops identical): uniform rgba(255,0,0,.5) over white = (255, 127.5, 127.5) -> (255,128,128) +/-1 for rounding, at EVERY x. Isolates source-over compositing from interpolation; a failure here invalidates every other row in this file.

GA_BlueToTransparent_White._note: Second hue, so a red-only coincidence cannot pass. SPEC over white: (255t, 255t, 255) -> t=.5 (128,128,255). NAIVE: t=.5 (128,128,191). Blue channel must read 255 at every x.

GA_BlueToTransparentBlue_White._note: CONTROL for the row above: (255t, 255t, 255). Must be pixel-identical to GA_BlueToTransparent_White.
